about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A student beginning his journey into computer science.
intro: My name is Muhammad Umar, and I am a Pakistani student currently studying Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at GUTECH in Karongi.

I am currently in my first semester, which means I am at the beginning of my academic journey in computer science. I am using this stage of my education to understand the fundamentals of programming, computing, problem solving, and technology.

I have started learning C++ and I am gradually becoming more comfortable with programming concepts. My current focus is not on claiming advanced expertise, but on building a strong foundation that I can continue developing throughout my degree.
I believe computer science is a field where learning never really stops. There are always new programming languages, frameworks, technologies, ideas, and problems to explore.

My long-term career goal is to become a Computer Scientist. I want to develop strong technical knowledge, gain practical experience, build meaningful projects, and eventually contribute to useful technology solutions.
This portfolio represents the beginning of that journey. As I learn more, complete projects, develop new skills, and gain experience, I plan to continue improving and expanding it.

personalStatement.long: I am Muhammad Umar, a Pakistani student currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at GUTECH in Karongi. As a first-semester student, I am at the beginning of an exciting journey into the world of computer science. I am currently developing my programming fundamentals and learning C++. I am interested in understanding how computers and software work, solving problems through programming, and exploring different areas of technology. I do not yet have extensive professional experience or a large project portfolio, but I see that as part of my journey. My goal is to learn consistently, build practical skills, create meaningful projects as I progress through university, and eventually become a Computer Scientist.
